notes.title: "The Electric Ruins" Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Space Cadets![/h1]

We are super proud to announce the release of our newest We Are Screwed! update! A new Universe is now available: [b]The Electric Ruins[/b]. The update includes the first two areas of the Ruins, as well as its Corrupted version, the [b]Ruined Ruins[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/680a318481507d524920bf9d72765805c6e2a265.gif[/img]

These new maps will unveil new quests and NPCs, as well as new enemies and, of course, terrifying bosses! But don’t worry, you’ll get new Modules to deal with them. Also, be ready to deal with even more chaos inside the ship as we are introducing the [b]Power Outage[/b]! Talking about ships, there is a new one to discover and it has a very silly interior and some unique gameplay... will you find it? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/ced1c47ae03fa4a6ada3bf55d092ee5c0262ca9d.gif[/img]

We can’t wait for you to see what we’ve prepared for you, and we dearly hope you enjoy it! We would love to hear your feedback and thoughts on our game, it helps us greatly to improve it and add more exciting content. Therefore, we would like to invite you to follow us on social media, which we are regularly monitoring, and would love to communicate with you there, as well as our Discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/010bbe1f864bdd46bc32a1f3d88fdbdf4748ac23.gif[/img]

Follow us below:

[url= https://www.wearescrewedgame.com/ ]Website[/url] | [url=https://www.facebook.com/rarebyte  ]Facebook[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/rarebyte/ ]Instagram[/url] |  [url=https://twitter.com/RarebyteGameDev/ ]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@wearescrewedgame ]TikTok[/url] | [url=https://www.youtube.com/Rarebyte ]YouTube[/url] | [url=https://discord.gg/rarebyte ]Discord[/url]

We hope you enjoy this update!

Safe Manoeuvres! 
[b]Your team at Rarebyte[/b]


[b]Full notes below: [/b]
[h1]0.6.63 Patch Notes[/h1]
25.10.2023
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new stages 
[*] Added new Corrupted Rift
[*] Added new stage-specific mechanics
[*] Added new enemies and new bosses
[*] Added Power Outage mechanic
[*] Added new playable characters
[*] Added new ship
[*] Added new Corrupted Modules
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted map generation to offer more variety within a run
[*] Reduced amount of levels per run in later stages
[*] Reworked amount of chunks in all stages, making earlier runs shorter and later runs less sluggish
[*] Improved single-player experience by drastically reducing tasks players have to do simultaneously
[*] Improved health pill effect for single-player - they now also clear fire, infestation, etc.
[*] Reduced difficulty in all levels
[*] Removed stage-specific enemies from stages they do not belong to (e.g. fire enemies will only appear in the Blazing Scrapyard, infested enemies will only appear in the Infested Swamps, etc.)
[*] Adjusted Timer Challenge difficulty to be a lot more challenging
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new Warp unlock mechanic: Players now have to complete different quests, other than just fetching the key in order to progress in a run
[*] Added a HUD element to inform players about their current objective within a level
[*] Added an animation to the Cargo Entrance to show when it is full
[*] Added additional upgrades to Hull and Damage Upgrader 
[*] Adjusted input layout to be less confusing for new players 
[*] Added possibility to add save files to bug reports
[*] Updated dialog HUD to improve visual clarity
[*] Added an introduction screen to display which Corrupted Module players carry in Corrupted Rifts
[*] Reworked objective markers to be more uniform and less confusing 
[*] Reworked wrench hit detection, making it easier to hit objects within the ship
[*] Reworked map introduction and added visualization of run progression
[*] Reworked Teleslurper to be less clunky
[*] Reworked charging modules to not go into cooldown when spamming the fire input, thus being less punishing for players
[*] Reworked the first test chamber minigame to always be free
[*] Adjusted colors in the Infested Swamps and during Warp   
[*] Adjusted passive module Baddie Detector minimap icon to match the module icon 
[*] Improved scavenger movement behavior
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem with meteor shower trails creating visual artifacts 
[*] Fixed Drill Worm turrets not pausing during stasis
[*] Fixed player input getting stuck after ejection from a ship site while holding a tool
[*] Fixed the soft lock of the game when disconnecting all players during a tutorial
[*] Fixed lingering "Freebie" text on pedestals after picking up the item on them
[*] Fixed non-removable floor infestation 
[*] Fixed item throw indicators not being hidden when players emote 
[*] Fixed inspect panels not positioning properly on higher resolutions 
[*] Fixed the control remapper not properly remapping controls 
[*] Fixed missing input glyphs in module descriptions 
[*] Fixed mines spawned by the Accidental Assist Corrupted Module exploding on damage, causing them to disappear immediately after spawning 
[*] Fixed the player continuing to walk after running over the level start buttons
[*] Fixed text in the bug report window not being localized
[*] Fixed the level selection screen not returning to the proper level window (Corrupted Rifts, Main Missions)
[*] Fixed map size randomization not working properly, forcing all levels in a stage to be equally large 
[*] Fixed shotgun and burst enemies not shooting the correct amount of projectiles
[*] Fixed passive module Reinforced Window breaking the ship health display 
[*] Fixed tool station items being tiny when reprinting them during teleportation 
[*] Fixed start turrets not spawning properly after using an extra life 
[*] Fixed enemy packs sometimes not spawning rewards
[*] Fixed the issue of enemy packs never spawning rewards in challenges 
[*] Fixed enemy packs not having the same marker color for each enemy in the pack 
[*] Fixed the level timer not showing in the pause menu 
[*] Fixed mines becoming immortal if they were shielded after being shot
[*] Fixed level enemies spawning during and invading challenges
[*] Fixed challenge borders damaging the ship when opening 
[*] Fixed timer challenges not pausing during stasis
[*] Fixed the ship taking damage during cutscenes 
[*] Fixed scavenger homing turret shooting behavior 
[*] Fixed enemy healer modules continuing to work during cutscenes and while stasis is active
[/list]

notes.title: "The Corrupted Rifts" Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Space Cadets![/b]

We’re happy to announce that we have dropped another We Are Screwed! update for you. [b]The Corrupted Rifts[/b] update introduces side missions that take players into twisted universes, where they need to deliver a [b]Corrupted Module[/b] before it overheats and destroys the ship. These timed challenges consist of multiple levels where players will be able to test their skills in fast-paced missions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/8254bd440697c6d4facff05821a74f08969642ab.gif[/img]

The goal of Corrupted Rifts missions is to deliver the dangerous cargo to [b]“The Sealer''[/b], the only being in the multiverse who can defuse it. This rat-like creature will generously reward players with module variants, passive modules and in-game currency. Full update notes can be read below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/c11a4f2b7a3595c4f95357eee26249cdbe3c5d0a.gif[/img]

We can’t wait for you to see what we’ve prepared for you, and we dearly hope you enjoy it! As a developer, we would love to hear your feedback and thoughts on our game, it helps us greatly to improve it and add more exciting content. Therefore, we would like to invite you to follow us on social media, which we are regularly monitoring and would love to communicate with you there, as well as our [url=https://discord.gg/rarebyte]Discord[/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/2fe4313957d3bc9a9a2131775c4e348d7622ff28.gif[/img]

You can check out our full update roadmap below.

notes.title: Star Blaster Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/63fc43c4574ab60fbfcb9c6bfab92b175a45950c.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello Space Cadets![/b]

We’re happy to announce that we have dropped another We Are Screwed! update for you. The update introduces new features such as the new ship modules. The ‟Black Hole Turret” will release a small black hole that will travel towards your enemies, sucking them in causing them to take damage, in addition a new ‟Star Blaster” will be added. In terms of accessibility, a Control Remapper will be introduced that will allow players to configure/remap controls according to their gaming preferences.

We can’t wait for you to see what we’ve prepared for you, and we dearly hope you enjoy it! As a developer, we would love to hear your feedback and thoughts on our game, it helps us greatly to improve it and add more exciting content. Therefore, we would like to invite you to follow us on social media, which we are regularly monitoring and would love to communicate with you there, as well as our Discord.

You can check out our full update roadmap below.

[b]Full notes below:[/b]
[h2]0.4.53 Patch Notes[/h2]
June 7th 2023

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- Added Black Hole Turret
- Added Star Blaster
- Added Exting-Squish to give players a second option to extinguish fires
- Carrying heavy washing machines to Scrappy didn't feel as rewarding as we wanted it to be, so we added some variety to the amount of scrap you earn from it. Heavier items will reward more, and lighter ones will reward less
- Enabled arrow key menu navigation for keyboard players
- Replaced input system to improve game performance
- Added input remapper to allow players to reassign controls on their input device
- Nerfed the amount of items spawned by a clean bot in Infested Swamps
- Nerfed enemies in four-player mode in later stages as they were too bulky and spawning too frequently
- Improve BF-S-G penalty cooldown to make it less punishing

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
- Added a cooldown indicator for chargeable modules such as the BF-S-G and the new Black Hole Turret
- Added a cooling mechanic to overheating modules such as the Gatling Gun. Spraying those turrets with a Fire Extinguisher or the new Exting-Squish item will cause them to overheat slower and cool down faster
- Added visualization for the item throwing mechanic
- Fixed Infested Swamps strains often spawning inside of walls
- Fixed an issue where Dusty would get stuck while cleaning
- Fixed a bug where locked chests would spawn underneath quests
- Fixed an issue where pickups could not be collected but were instead rotating around the ship
- Fixed a bug where stealing from the shop would not trigger a warning message by Ceasar
- Fixed a bug where unlocked module variants would not display in the upgrade panel anymore
- Improved localizations
- Minor balancing changes

[h1]Known issues:[/h1]
- Turning on Stasis in the ship and then disabling the option in the options menu will break all the enemies in the game

notes.title: The Second Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Space Cadets![/b]

We have prepared a recent update for We Are Screwed! for you! The update introduces new features such as the C.O.D.E.X, which is a Compendium of Objects, Discoveries, Encounters, and Xenotechnology that will allow you to track your progress, discoveries and more. Along with new features we’ll introduce some buffs, fixes, and adjustments along with an improved ship layout for the Junk Fighter and a great number of optimizations. [b]You can find full list of changes down below.[/b]

You can check out our full update roadmap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/1a059ef827bcb9a1b4858a5362aac1201d436b3f.png[/img]

We are overjoyed to have you all see the latest update and test it for yourselves! In addition, we would like to warmly welcome you to our socials where you can follow us closely for updates but also send us feedback. We would love to hear your comments on what you want to see, improve or change in We Are Screwed! Furthermore, we would also like to discuss your likes and dislikes and invite you to ask us questions or just chat with us. Where? Below you will find media where we are available day-by-day ;)

notes.title: The First Update is LIVE
notes.content:
Suit up, Space Cadets! The first update of We Are Screwed! just launched and we have packed a bunch of other out-of-this-world announcements! Put your Extravehicular Visor Assembly on and let's take a closer look..

[h2]F[reakingly] Big Space Gun[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/S1cytac.gif[/img]
Charge up a big plasma ball with the F-BSG turret that once fired, will zap nearby enemies for significant amounts of damage! The key to operating the F-BSG Module is to shoot the plasma ball close to the enemies while also avoiding hitting them.


[h2]Mine Launcher[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WjX0UZl.gif[/img]
The Mine Launcher launches up to 5 mines into space, that work exactly like the regular mines. Using the Mine Launcher, you can create minefields and traps for enemies or use them for chaining up an explosive surprise. Be sure to keep your distance though, these mines can hit your spaceship with a mighty blast!


[h2]Enemy Groups[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZJ7BUPT.gif[/img]
Some enemies prefer hanging out in groups with a bigger, faster, and tankier Leader in their midst! These groups will be randomly generated depending on the level and have a possibility to be marked. Taking out every single enemy of a marked group will reward you with awesome equipment! 


[h2]Hands Off Turret[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2q5dpbj.gif[/img]
This turret reflects enemy projectiles back towards them: You basically shoot them with their own bullets! PS: It can also be used to push enemies away a bit. Into a pit. In space.


That's not all!
[h2]Verified on Steam Deck![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/bb3ce6daa8211fb9a74a2ae074e81754d67fb32d.png[/img]
We're over the moon to announce that We Are Screwed! is now [b]Verified[/b] on the Steam Deck! Check it out and let us know how it runs!


And to make this update even more stellar.. 
[h2]First Update (and a little bit of Easter) Sale![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/ac3c75f7058ac3c2dea377e5e5ffb810d5449d8c.png[/img]
We Are Screwed! is now officially 15% off until Sunday, April 9th! If you're up for the challenge of going on an intergalactic adventure alone or with fellow crewmates, now is the best time.


Full notes below:
[h1]0.2.46 Patch Notes[/h1]
APRIL 6TH 2023

[b][h2]Changes[/h2][/b]
- Nerfed shotgun enemies

- Barrel Launcher and its variants were replaced with the new and improved Mine Launcher

- Moved Burster, Super Laser and Gatling Gun from the shop to the upgrade room. Their variants can now be unlocked with Energy Cores like other turrets 
- Added minimap icons to chests, cheese deposits and scrap deposits

[b][h2]Fixes[/h2][/b]
- Fixed overeager fire alarm on derelicts, sounding before the fire starts

- Fixed payment hand appearing on derelicts, one does not simply pay for derelicts! 
- Fixed issue where floor infestation did not change visuals when being frozen 
- Fixed issue where worm boss kept moving while stasis is active 
- Fixed a visual glitch where bots would appear inactive while being active 
- Fixed missing Super Laser sound effects  
- Fixed PS4 controller icons 
- Fixed an issue where installing both the Favour Returner and Hedgehog could cause an infinite loop of damage (whoopsie!)

- Worm boss stages fps drops

That's all for today, Space Cadets!

notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Today we wanted to share with you what we've been working on in the past weeks. 
Since the game is still a huge WIP, we won't get into much detail, but here are some small glimpses of what we have been doing: 

- We introduced a few more characters! 
- We have more shopkeepers! 
- More weapons!
- New enemies!  
- More levels!
- New ships! 
- More cats! 
- We fixed a bunch of bugs 8) 
- We are working on some QoL changes 


Since we have shown mostly gameplay from the free demo we had at the Steam Festival recently on our streams, we will now move along to try and give you more insight in recent builds, even if they're not fully stable :) 
So there are many things that can be discovered in our streams! 
Make sure to follow us and let us know if you want to jump into the game and save the multi-verse with us.
